name: Yang-Ball Parametrization of the Dismantlable-Ample Basis
statement: An irredundant ample family $X\subseteq Q_d$ is pc-minimal outside dismantlable ampleness exactly when its Yang complex is a nonshellable constructible $(d-1)$-ball, every link at a literal vertex is shellable, and every induced deletion of both literal vertices of one coordinate is shellable. Hence the complete basis consists of the antipodally punctured cubes and these color-minimal nonshellable Yang balls, modulo color permutations and reorientations; no iterated-link or additional pc-minor test is needed.
proof: The Yang complex of a restriction is the link at the retained literal, and the Yang complex of a contraction is the induced deletion of the corresponding literal pair. The ball theorem makes an ample family dismantlable exactly when its Yang ball is shellable. Thus shellability of the $3d$ displayed elementary color minors is precisely the elementary pc-minor condition in the colored-ideal parametrization. Pc-minor closure handles all iterated minors, while the nonample-layer theorem supplies the punctured-cube part.
